old_work_policy: Read-only committed reference; no merge or cherry-pick.
execution_storage_policy: Ignored task-owned work with unique per-track and per-attempt namespaces; small records and authored source remain durable.
cgroup_quota: cpu.max and memory.max unavailable at inspected cgroup-v2 paths; no inferred unlimited quota claim
random_seed_policy: Each random experiment records independent explicit seeds in its own protocol; no inherited campaign seeds.
measurement_policy: Define component moment, cost, physical replay and target sensitivity before interpreting improvements; keep finite and asymptotic scope separate.
initial_process_inspection: Read comm/elapsed/CPU/RSS only; no old research computation observed among largest resident user processes; no processes controlled.
